subtitle: Pick what you want, and see the result on the right at once.
loadError: The report designer could not be opened.

start.subtitle: Start from a ready report or from a question.

ready.title: Start from a ready report
ready.none: There are no ready reports yet.
ready.error: Could not make a copy. Try again.

keyboard.hint: Keyboard: Tab to move, Enter to add, Alt+↑ or Alt+↓ to change the order, Ctrl+S to save.

empty.title: Pick something to see the result
empty.explanation: On the left, add something to Show, Split by or Count.

save.title: Save this report
save.description: Give it a name and choose who can see it.
save.saved: The report is saved. Only you can see it for now.
save.published: The report is on for everyone.
save.error: The report could not be saved. Try again.
save.publishError: The report is saved, but it could not be switched on. Press "Switch on for everyone" again.

errors.NOT_GROUPABLE: These two cannot be split together: {{field}} and Count. Take one away.
errors.NOTHING_TO_SHOW: Pick something to show: add at least one to Show or Count.
errors.NOT_FILTERABLE: This cannot be used to narrow the list. Remove it from "Only those who…".
errors.BAD_OP: This word does not fit that detail. Pick another word.
errors.BAD_VALUE: This value does not fit. Write it again.
errors.MISSING_PARAM: Set a starting answer for the question that is asked when the report runs.
errors.UNKNOWN_PARAM: A question is not joined to any condition. Remove the question.
errors.NOT_SORTABLE: It cannot be put in this order.
errors.UNKNOWN_FIELD: A detail you picked is no longer there. Remove it and pick again.
errors.generic: The result could not be fetched. Try again in a moment.
errors.keyClash: This report was already made. Open the page again.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.description: Your changes are not saved. If you leave now they are lost.

copy.title: "{{name}}" cannot be changed directly
copy.explanation: Make a copy and change that. The original stays as it is.
copy.error: Could not make a copy. Try again.
